newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's SFC chairman to meet China stock regulator.
newsitem.headline: HK's SFC chairman to meet China stock regulator.

text.p: The chairman of Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission (SFC), Anthony Neoh, will meet China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) chairman Zhou Daojiong in Beijing next week, a SFC spokesman said.
"He will attend the ISOCO meeting in Beijing next week," the spokesman told Reuters on Friday. He said Neoh and Zhou would meet but declined to disclose what they would talk about.

Local newspapers said on Friday that Neoh was due to discuss regulatory issues surrounding red chips, China-related shares listed in Hong Kong, during an International Organisation of Securities Commissions (IOSCO) meeting next week.

Analysts said a last minute regulatory hurdle during the recent listing of GITIC Enterprises Ltd, a Hong Kong company that is indirectly controlled by the Guangdong International Trust and Investment Corp (GITIC), had raised concerns about China's attitude towards red chip listings.
"Apparently they want to be involved in red chips and they want to play a predominant role," said Kent Rossiter, institutional sales manager at Nikko Securities.
"I think from the investor standpoint, they would rather have less intervention," he said.
